build_evaluation_prompt: build a prompt to evaluate Python docstring attribute descriptions using DocstringAttributeEvaluator
parse_llm_response: parse an LLM response to extract a numerical score and analysis from score tags
get_criteria_description: get the main evaluation criteria description for docstring attribute quality assessment
get_score_criteria: get the criteria description for a specific ScoreLevel like EXCELLENT or POOR
get_examples: get all evaluation examples showing attribute description quality levels from POOR to EXCELLENT
